title: Loro catalog phrase
description: Ids are IMMUTABLE — fixing a typo mutates the row; changing the meaning creates a new id and deprecates the old one.

es.description: The phrase, with full punctuation including ¿ and ¡.

en.description: What an English speaker would ACTUALLY say — not a gloss.

theme.description: Exactly one. If a phrase fits two equally, it's too vague.

emoji.description: Row identity at a glance. Exactly one.

register.description: Default to neutral. Over-formality is the most common content failure.

resp.description: English-speaker respelling, hyphenated, CAPS on the stressed syllable. Must be readable by someone who has never seen IPA.

resp_ipa.description: For alignment and fix selection, not display.

gloss.description: May be literal — that's its job.

say.description: REQUIRED when `es` is a fragment: '¿Dón' → 'dónde'. The chips are tappable and must speak a real word.

example.description: The phrase VERBATIM inside a longer, natural sentence. Shows where it sits in real speech.

hint.description: A real mnemonic — etymology or imagery. NEVER a restatement of the translation.

note.description: The default coaching line for the labs: ONE concrete physical fix.

syl.description: Produced by the render pipeline from the rendered audio and resp_ipa.

f0_native.description: 14-point normalised contour — what the prosody chart draws. Scoring uses the full-resolution track.

variants.description: Regional variants. Keeps es-419 cheap later.

deprecated_by.description: Set when the MEANING changed. The old phrase stays resolvable FOREVER — a learner who owns it must never see a broken row.
